title: investigation_report
description: Investigation reports about the loss: fire marshal / fire department reports, police reports, and adjuster or independent investigator reports.

incident_date.description: Date of the incident, as YYYY-MM-DD.

loss_location.description: Address or description of where the loss happened.

cause_or_origin.description: Stated cause, or point of origin for fires.

findings.description: Key findings or conclusions of the report.

parties_involved.description: People or organizations involved and their role.

report_author_or_agency.description: Author, investigator, or agency that issued the report.
